## Checklist

- [ ] No fabricated citations, metrics, integrations, or certainty
- [ ] Naming hierarchy preserved (Product / Method / Companion infrastructure)
- [ ] No exaggerated language ("revolutionary", "production-grade", "guarantees correctness", "fully autonomous")
